neighbours.label: the token 'enn' after an i-stem, as in bi|enn|ale, tri|enn|ium, anci|enn|eté, Si|enn|ese
fire: Venice opens its art biennale every other summer.
The Milan Triennale showcases new furniture designs.
Funding is approved once each triennium by the council.
Le congrès quadriennal aura lieu à Melbourne en mai.
The museum holds several Siennese paintings from the fourteenth century.
Le règlement tient compte de l'ancienneté des employés.
The budget for the next biennium was approved in June.
Every September the city of Lyon hosts a dance biennale.
quiet: Venice opens its art festival every other summer.
The Milan fair showcases new furniture designs.
Funding is approved once each year by the council.
Le congrès annuel aura lieu à Melbourne en mai.
The museum holds several Venetian paintings from the fourteenth century.
Le règlement tient compte de l'expérience des employés.
The budget for the next fiscal year was approved in June.
Every September the city of Lyon hosts a dance festival.

notes: Probe: Biennale 0.67, biennium 0.61, ancienneté 0.72. 'enn' after other letters (F|enn|imore 0.07, G|enn|aro 0.03) and ' mean' (≤0.02) were quiet, so the label is narrowed to i+enn. Quiet items swap the word for a synonym with no 'enn' piece.
